description: The line plot illustrates the performance of two methods, 0-CoT and CoRe, in terms of missing step accuracy across four different values on the x-axis, which are labeled as 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4. The y-axis, labeled "Missing Step," represents the accuracy, ranging from 0.845 to 0.860. The 0-CoT method is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, while the CoRe method is shown with an orange solid line and triangular markers. Both lines start at a value of approximately 0.859 when the x-axis value is 0. As the x-axis value increases, the missing step accuracy for both methods decreases. The 0-CoT method shows a steady decline, reaching a value of approximately 0.845 at an x-axis value of 4. The CoRe method also declines but at a slower rate, ending at approximately 0.848 at an x-axis value of 4. The CoRe method consistently achieves a higher missing step accuracy than the 0-CoT method across all x-axis values.
